description: Pennix v0.7 beta parallel evidence workflow contracts
changelog:
**Improvements:**
- Add project-local subnode evidence profiles with deterministic model/reasoning resolution and durable spawn receipts.
- Add a write-once FIFO queue helper with fail-closed claims and abandonment markers for coordinator-driven dispatch.
- Align the Marketplace workflow with profile selection, acceptance gates, recovery, and queue boundaries.
notes: Run npm install -g @pennixrv/trellis@beta then trellis update. No --migrate required.
